summary: Visual decompiler and disassembler for compiled Daedalus scripts used by the ZenGin engine in Gothic and Gothic II.

name: bugz
subject: Z80 machine code
provenanceNote: Repo created 2016, predates AI coding tools (GitHub)
summary: Very small table-driven Z80 disassembler written in portable C89.

name: dashlink
subject: HashLink bytecode (Haxe)
provenanceNote: Repo created 2022, predates AI coding tools (GitHub)
summary: Haxe library to disassemble, inspect, edit and write HashLink bytecode, adapted largely from the hlbc Rust disassembler.

name: REshare
subject: Reverse-engineering databases (Ghidra, IDA, Binary Ninja, radare2)
summary: Human- and machine-readable exchange format for reverse-engineering knowledge, with importers and exporters to move symbols and notes between disassemblers.

name: gditools3
subject: Dreamcast GD-ROM images
provenanceNote: Repo created 2018, predates AI coding tools (GitHub)
summary: Python 2/3 library, CLI and GUI for listing and extracting files from Dreamcast GD-ROM images; a fork of dcisotools.

name: psprecomp (sp00nznet)
subject: PSP Allegrex/MIPS executables
summary: Static recompilation toolkit for PSP games with analysis tools, a code generator and runtime libraries that turn Allegrex MIPS code into C.

name: slinky
subject: Linker scripts for matching decompilation projects
summary: Linker script generator for GNU ld and LLVM lld, built to produce the scripts matching decompilation and modding projects need.

name: GMD Recovery
subject: GameMaker 5.3a and earlier project files
provenanceNote: Repo created 2012, predates AI coding tools (GitHub)
summary: Visual Basic 6 decompiler that recovers projects from games made with GameMaker 5.3a and earlier.

name: mist
subject: PSP Allegrex MIPS code
provenanceNote: Repo created 2018, predates AI coding tools (GitHub)
summary: Experimental Kotlin MIPS toolkit for the PSP Allegrex CPU: disassembler, symbolic execution engine used to verify uofw reverse engineering, recompiler and decompiler.

name: il2csharp
subject: Unity IL2CPP binaries
provenanceNote: CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md in repo root (GitHub)
summary: IL2CPP-to-C# decompiler that lifts method bodies from native x64 code and cross-checks them with IL2CPP metadata to produce a C# source tree.

name: isDcc
subject: InstallShield scripts (up to v5.5)
summary: Upload of ADQ's InstallShield script decompiler, covering InstallShield versions up to 5.5.

name: LibOpenNFS
subject: Need for Speed 1-5 asset formats
provenanceNote: Repo created 2020, predates AI coding tools (GitHub)
summary: Reverse-engineered parsers and format notes for the data files of the early Need for Speed games, used by the OpenNFS engine to load assets.

name: NFSMW Reverse-Engineering Project
subject: Need for Speed: Most Wanted (2005) PC
summary: Reverse-engineering notes and modding tools for the PC Need for Speed: Most Wanted, mapping its subsystems and attribute hashes, with an ASI mod and a Linux CLI.

name: SLGSystemScriptTool
subject: SLG System engine scripts
provenanceNote: Repo created 2021, predates AI coding tools (GitHub)
summary: GUI tool that decompiles, compiles, decrypts and encrypts scripts for every known version of the SLG System game engine, including key finding.

name: Helix
subject: Decompiled N64 games being ported to PC
summary: Library that gives N64 decompilations a libultra runtime with real threads plus a modern renderer, audio and input so they run on PC with minimal changes.

name: Decomplicator
subject: N64 decompilation build environments
summary: Windows tool that sets up a build environment for N64 decompilation projects from templates, given a project folder and the base cartridge image.

name: MiniWorldPkgUnpacker
subject: Mini World resource packages (Rainbow engine)
provenanceNote: AGENTS.md in repo root describes agent workflow (GitHub)
summary: Unpacker and texture decoder for Mini World's reverse-engineered Rainbow engine package format, converting ASTC, Crunch and ETC2 textures to PNG.

name: Xbox XBE Recomp
subject: Original Xbox XBE executables
summary: Static recompiler that translates original Xbox x86 executables to C++ and implements the kernel and XDK libraries on Windows, with Direct3D 12 and XAudio2 back ends.

name: swe1r-assets
subject: Star Wars Episode I: Racer asset files
summary: C#/.NET library that reads, edits and writes the block asset files of Star Wars Episode I: Racer.

name: Shenmue-Export-Tools
subject: Shenmue model and texture files
provenanceNote: Repo created 2018, predates AI coding tools (GitHub)
summary: Blender and Noesis plugins that read Shenmue's MT5 model files and PowerVR textures, including the game's twiddled rectangular images, for mesh export.

name: War Tool Kit
subject: Sudden Strike, Sudden Strike Resource War and Sudden Strike 2 data files
summary: Tools for reading and writing the internal data files of Fireglow's Sudden Strike games, mostly produced by reverse engineering the original binaries.

name: SCTParser
subject: Yuna Engine SCT images (Chaos Zero Nightmare, Epic Seven)
summary: Small C# converter that parses the custom SCT image format used by Yuna Engine games such as Chaos Zero Nightmare and writes PNGs; its work has moved into a larger asset ripper.

name: Emotion Engine Disassembler
subject: PlayStation 2 Emotion Engine machine code
provenanceNote: Repo created 2020, predates AI coding tools (GitHub)
summary: Early-stage C# disassembler for the PlayStation 2 Emotion Engine CPU instruction set; register naming and tests were still unfinished when work stopped.

name: Zydec
subject: x64 machine code
summary: Small library that turns Zydis-disassembled x64 instructions into C-like pseudo-code, aimed at skimming vectorised code and mapping it back to intrinsics.

name: CodeReverse2
subject: Windows executables (PE)
provenanceNote: Repo created 2020, predates AI coding tools (GitHub)
summary: Command-line reverse-engineering tool that inspects Windows executables and DLLs, dumping headers, imports, memory and disassembly; runs on Windows, Linux and macOS.

name: IDO matching decomp
subject: SGI IRIX IDO compiler
provenanceNote: Repo created 2022, predates AI coding tools (GitHub)
summary: Matching decompilation of the IRIX Development Option C compiler programs (cc, cfe, uopt, ugen, as1) used to build many N64 games, as support for other decompilations.

name: gbarecomp
subject: Game Boy Advance ARM/Thumb code
summary: Static recompiler that finds ARM and Thumb code in Game Boy Advance games, translates it to C and generates a CMake project linked against a small GBA runtime with SDL2.

name: CHIP-8 Recompiled
subject: CHIP-8 programs
summary: Static recompilation toolchain that turns CHIP-8 programs into C and builds them as standalone native executables with a small runtime.

name: decomp.wtf
subject: Matching decompilation of N64, GameCube and Wii games
provenanceNote: AI-agent decomp tool: ships a .claude-plugin and has agents (Claude Code, Codex) write the matching C (README, repo root)
summary: Local tool that drives an AI coding agent through matching decompilation of games the user owns, scoring each function by whether it compiles back to the original bytes. The author has discontinued it.

name: RecompCore
subject: GameCube executables (Dolphin CPU core)
provenanceNote: README states it is fully vibecoded, written by AI under the author's direction
summary: Static-recompilation CPU core for Dolphin that runs GameCube game code as native code and falls back to the interpreter where needed.

name: nWiiURecomp
subject: Wii U executables
provenanceNote: AGENTS.md in repo root (GitHub)
summary: Static recompiler and Cafe OS HLE runtime that turn Wii U executables into native C++ programs; derived from the same team's NWiiRecomp.

name: N64 Decomp Workbench
subject: N64 MIPS matching decompilation
summary: Diagnostic tool for nearly-matched MIPS functions in N64 decomps, with relocation-aware diffs, compiler traces and pass replay to locate the cause of a mismatch.

name: ECD++
subject: Java class files (Eclipse)
provenanceNote: Repo created 2022, predates AI coding tools (GitHub)
summary: Fork of Enhanced Class Decompiler that integrates several modern Java decompilers into Eclipse.

name: AI5WINScriptTool
subject: AI5WIN visual novel engine scripts
provenanceNote: Repo created 2021, predates AI coding tools (GitHub)
summary: Dual-language tool that decompiles and recompiles the mes scripts of the AI5WIN visual novel engine, allowing full script edits.

name: WiiCompiled
subject: Wii and GameCube PowerPC executables (first target: Mario Kart Wii)
summary: Static recompiler and runtime that turns Wii/GameCube PowerPC game code into native PC programs, first used for a Mario Kart Wii port and since by several other ports. Translation runs locally against your own disc.

name: PSXRecomp
subject: PlayStation (MIPS R3000A) games
provenanceNote: CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md in repo root; README mentions AI-assisted work (GitHub)
summary: General-purpose static recompiler for PlayStation games: MIPS R3000A code from a disc is translated to C and linked against a hardware-accurate runtime. Maintained by mstan within Retro Porting Toolkit.

name: SWBF2 Browser Reconstruction
subject: Star Wars Battlefront II (2017) data
summary: Pipeline that converts maps from your own Star Wars Battlefront II (2017) install into browser formats and plays them in a three.js runtime.
